messages:
mia: quick question — do we want service-account delegation to carry project/tenant routing affinity? I'm worried about billing attribution if tokens get exchanged across projects.
alex: probably yes by default? but we need a knob for "delegate_inherits_billing" or similar. :thinking_face:
sam: ugh billing/quotas pain. If we bind delegated tokens to original project, quotas could be double-counted or hidden.
maddie: idea: add an explicit telemetry field 'effective_origin' and expose both 'issuer' and 'consumer' in metrics so dashboards can decide how to roll up.
alex: +1. Telemetry schema needs issuer_id, consumer_id, effective_origin, route_affinity, quota_key. then dashboards can roll up properly.
mia: prototype payload snippet we discussed:
```json
{"issuer":"sa:project-foo","consumer":"svc:analytics","effective_origin":"project-foo","route_pref":"origin_affine"}
```
sam: also need to decide console UX — when creating a delegation, show "Charge usage to issuer (recommended)" checkbox (default on?) and a short explainer about billing/quotas.
maddie: For rollout, suggest a feature flag: delegated_affinity=beta. Enable in a few opt-in orgs for 2 weeks, measure cost delta + attribution correctness.
alex: what signals do we measure? percent of requests where issuer!=consumer, total tokens double-attributed, distinct projects affected, avg latency impact, quota hits spike. :clipboard:
mia: quota enforcement implication: current limiter keys = request.key.project. If we switch to effective_origin, rate limiter needs to use that OR we need to fanout accounting to both issuer and consumer.
sam: fanout safer for correctness but doubles write QPS and storage of counters. conditional approach might be: if delegation and issuer_wants_inherit then attribute to issuer, else to consumer.
maddie: Ops/dashboard question: how surfaced? Add a "Delegation" filter in top-level request breakdown that can toggle between issuer/consumer/effective_origin. Also add a little icon next to requests that were delegated.
alex: Ok next steps (agreed): - design telemetry proto (maddie) - draft console copy + UX mock (mia) - implement flag-gated routing/quota change and opt-in behavior (sam) - add instrumentation + dashboard widgets (alex)
mia: for console copy keep it non-technical: "Charge usage to the original service (recommended)" vs "Charge usage to the calling project". Add a short "why this matters" link.
sam: +1. also add an audit-log entry whenever delegation is created/modified and when the billing-affinity preference is toggled.
infra-bot: deploy-canary: feature=delegated-affinity flag enabled in orgs: beta-org-7, beta-org-13 (canary created).
maddie: I'll draft the telemetry proto and include field descriptions; pinging @alex for sign-off on exact field names.
alex: also pinging @tara from billing to sanity-check pricing and invoice visibility. @tara any initial concerns?
tara: quick note — billing team prefers inherit=false by default to avoid surprise charges for customers. We can make inherit=true a migration path and highlight on the onboarding screen.
mia: ok let's document both defaults and a migration plan. Can we reconvene tomorrow same time to review the proto + mock?
alex: noon PT works for me.
